articles.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
articles.description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees
articles.description: The website builder said that the job losses are part of a broader restructuring of its organization.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
articles.description: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
articles.description: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
articles.description: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
articles.description: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
articles.description: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan
